# Playbook: refresh
Use when: build and activate a new code index (missing or stale)

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply.

## You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM workspace? (id)" |
| repository | the user: `https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>` or a workspace link id | STOP. Say: "Which repository? (https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>)" |
| date | today's UTC date as yyyy-mm-dd | — |
| smokeQuery | a file name in this repository the user named (never the repository name) | "README.md" |

## Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. The active code index was not changed."
1. CALL `get_mcp_connection_info` {} [A]
   IF result.credential == "oauth" → STOP. Say: "A refresh needs an owner/admin LPM API key."
2. CALL `list_workspace_repository_links` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>"} [A]
   SAVE: linkId = id of the item whose id == <input:repository> or whose canonicalRepositoryUrl == <input:repository> in lower case without ".git"; url = its canonicalRepositoryUrl; creator = its credentialOwnerId; key = "manual:<input:date>:<saved:linkId>"
   IF no item matches or it has agentVisible == false → STOP. Say: "<input:repository> has no visible workspace link. Run playbook link or change-link first."
3. CALL `get_repository_index_status` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>"} [A]
   SAVE: oldGeneration = result.pointer.generation; oldActiveId = result.pointer.activeIndexVersionId; oldCommit = result.pointer.expectedRepositoryCommitSha (pointer null → 0, "none", "none")
4. CALL `preview_repository_code_index` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error that contains "Private" → STOP. Say: "LPM cannot read <saved:url>: link creator <saved:creator> needs a personal GitHub credential in LPM, or an LPM admin the GitHub App."
   SAVE: commitSha, selectedFileCount, truncated = those fields of result
   VERIFY: CALL `get_repository_index_status` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.pointer.generation (pointer null → 0) != <saved:oldGeneration> → STOP. Say: "The index changed meanwhile. Run this playbook again."
   IF <saved:commitSha> == <saved:oldCommit> → STOP. Say: "<saved:url> is already indexed at the branch head <saved:commitSha> (version <saved:oldActiveId>)."
5. ASK: "Build a code index of <saved:url> at <saved:commitSha> (<saved:selectedFileCount> files, truncated <saved:truncated>; up to 9 min)? refresh_repository_code_index(workspaceId=<input:workspaceId>, repositoryLinkId=<saved:linkId>, commitSha=<saved:commitSha>, idempotencyKey=<saved:key>) (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
   A yes the user already wrote for this refresh ("I confirm") counts: go on.
6. CALL `refresh_repository_code_index` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>","commitSha":"<saved:commitSha>","idempotencyKey":"<saved:key>"} [C]
   IF the call returns an error that contains "document cap" → STOP. Say: "<saved:url> exceeds the 5,000-chunk build cap: an owner decision on LPM platform configuration. Nothing was activated."
   IF the call returns an error that contains "timeout" or "timed out" → STOP. Say: "The build may still run. Wait 10 minutes, then run this playbook again (same commit and key, same version)."
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "refresh failed: <error text>. Nothing was activated."
   SAVE: versionId = result.id; built = result.status; files = result.indexedFiles; chunks = result.searchableChunkCount
   VERIFY: CALL `get_repository_index_status` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.pointer.activeIndexVersionId (pointer null → "none") != <saved:oldActiveId> → STOP. Say: "The active index changed during the build. Run playbook check."
   SAVE: generation = result.pointer.generation (pointer null → 0)
   IF <saved:built> != "validating" → STOP. Say: "Build <saved:versionId> is <saved:built>, not validating; nothing was activated."
7. ASK: "Make <saved:versionId> (<saved:files> files, commit <saved:commitSha>) the live index of <saved:url> for every agent and the Advisor? activate_repository_code_index(workspaceId=<input:workspaceId>, versionId=<saved:versionId>, expectedGeneration=<saved:generation>) (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
   A yes the user already wrote for the activation ("I confirm both steps") counts: go on.
8. CALL `activate_repository_code_index` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","versionId":"<saved:versionId>","expectedGeneration":"<saved:generation>"} [C] (send <saved:generation> as a JSON number: 4, not "4")
   Send it once; never re-send it, even after an error: the VERIFY decides.
   VERIFY: CALL `get_repository_index_status` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.pointer.activeIndexVersionId != <saved:versionId> → STOP. Say: "<saved:versionId> is not active; activate was not re-sent. Run playbook check."
   SAVE: newGeneration = result.pointer.generation; activeCommit = result.pointer.expectedRepositoryCommitSha
9. CALL `search_workspace_code` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","query":"<input:smokeQuery>","limit":10} [A]
   IF the call returns an error → SAVE: smoke = "not run (<error text>)"; go to Answer.
   SAVE: smoke = "<path> (link <saved:linkId>, commit <saved:activeCommit>, lexicalMatch true)" of the first result with repositoryLinkId == <saved:linkId>, commitSha == <saved:activeCommit> and lexicalMatch == true (missing = false), else "inconclusive"
   VERIFY: CALL `get_repository_index_status` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.pointer.activeIndexVersionId != <saved:versionId> → STOP. Say: "<saved:versionId> is no longer active. Run playbook check."

## Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:workspaceId> / <saved:url> (link <saved:linkId>)
Done: <activated <saved:versionId> at <saved:activeCommit>, generation <saved:oldGeneration> -> <saved:newGeneration>; state after: current | nothing activated; state after: unchanged>
Evidence: <files <saved:files>, chunks <saved:chunks>, previous <saved:oldActiveId>; smoke <saved:smoke> | none>
Pending: <none | smoke <saved:smoke> — search <input:smokeQuery> again after 00:00 UTC>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run | none — index current at <saved:activeCommit>>
```
state after: current | unchanged; version states: validating | active | superseded | failed. Never claim a version, commit or generation that a VERIFY did not read (never from the activate response).
